title: Symmetric monoidal category
html:
Remark. Symmetric monoidal category

Symmetric monoidal category. A braided monoidal category whose braiding is involutive: \beta_{Y,X} \circ \beta_{X,Y} = \mathrm{id}_{X \otimes Y}.

Mathlib reference. CategoryTheory.SymmetricCategory (class). Import: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Monoidal.Braided.Basic.
